name: Matrix Plastic Products
old_description: Matrix Plastic Products is a premier custom manufacturer specializing in injection molding, moldmaking & assembly with surgical precision.  We partner with medical device manufacturers to engineer, tool up, and produce ultra-precise molded components and sub-assemblies for their most critical applications.
about:
Matrix Plastic Products operates from Wood Dale, Illinois, just outside Chicago. The company traces its roots to 1978 when it began as Matrix Tooling with seven employees and a family tradition of moldmaking craftsmanship. By 1994 the business had expanded into injection molding, and by 2000 it was running volume production in a facility that had doubled in size.

Today Matrix provides injection molding, moldmaking, and assembly with a focus on surgical precision. Its capabilities include scientific and decoupled molding processes, multi-shot molding, and micro molding for miniature components. The shop runs three shifts on presses ranging from 20 to 300 tons, employs 140 people, and is expanding from its current Wood Dale location to an 88,000-square-foot facility in nearby Bloomingdale. An ISO Class 8 cleanroom supports medical-grade molding and assembly.

The company serves global leaders in the medical device, electronics, personal care, and safety industries. Typical projects include minimally invasive surgical instruments, micro medical devices, and high-performance electronic components. Customers rely on Matrix for full traceability and device-history records that meet regulatory requirements.

Matrix differentiates itself through nearly five decades of in-house design-for-manufacturability and moldmaking expertise, a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016, and a culture that blends traditional craftsmanship with continuous investment in automation and inspection technology. The firm emphasizes reliability, responsiveness, and direct communication between project teams and customers.
